items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: Very, very personal friend of mine.

ctx.x: No, indeed. No? No lily bells. You want that harmony to come, too. Yeah. Rhythm. Rhythm, harmony, that's, that's all jazz is, nothing else.
Did you ever know a drummer named Joe H. Try?
I think I very well did. Very, very personal friend of mine.
